name: AL Language Isolation Probe
brief: Custom test runners that measure what BC's TestIsolation modes reset between tests.
description: Run only by the Windows nightly, with Run-TestsInBcContainer -testRunnerCodeunitId. The main corpus always runs under Microsoft's Test Runner - Isol. Codeunit (130450), and a test cannot start a second test runner (NavNCLTestCodeUnitNestedInvocationException), so the TestIsolation = Function behaviour can only be measured by a top-level runner of our own. Not part of ci.yml's Linux legs.
